error.not_apk: The file is not a readable APK.
error.not_zip: The file is not a valid APK archive.
error.too_large: The file is too large to analyze.
error.zip_bomb: The file has a suspicious structure (possible zip bomb) and was rejected.
finding.certificate.debug.advice: Not an official release: likely repackaged or a test build.
finding.certificate.debug.description: It is signed with Android's test key, not the developer's own.
finding.certificate.debug.title: Signed with a debug certificate
finding.certificate.expired.advice: Android does not block it, but it points to a neglected or very old build.
finding.certificate.expired.title: Expired certificate
finding.certificate.self_signed.advice: Comparing with the app's official signature is more meaningful.
finding.certificate.self_signed.descript: Nearly every Android app is: on its own it is no problem.
finding.certificate.self_signed.title: Self-signed certificate
finding.certificate.unsigned.description: The APK has no valid signature, so its origin cannot be verified.
finding.certificate.unsigned.title: App is not signed
finding.certificate.v1_only.advice: A modern app uses v2 or v3 signatures.
finding.certificate.v1_only.description: The signature is the legacy type, open to tampering on Android 5-8.
finding.certificate.v1_only.title: v1-only signature
finding.dex.accessibility_control.advice: Legitimate only for accessibility apps; many banking trojans abuse it.
finding.dex.accessibility_control.descri: The code simulates taps and gestures ({apis}).
finding.dex.accessibility_control.title: Can control the screen for you
finding.dex.anti_analysis.advice: Malware does this to behave well during analysis.
finding.dex.anti_analysis.description: The code contains checks for running inside an emulator ({markers}).
finding.dex.anti_analysis.title: Tries to detect emulators
finding.dex.device_admin_abuse.advice: Do not install unless it is a corporate device-management app.
finding.dex.device_admin_abuse.descripti: The code uses administrator functions ({apis}), typical of ransomware.
finding.dex.device_admin_abuse.title: Can lock or wipe the device
finding.dex.device_identifiers.descripti: It reads IMEI, phone number or similar ({apis}).
finding.dex.device_identifiers.title: Collects device identifiers
finding.dex.dynamic_loading.advice: Typical of malware that fetches its harmful part later; some ad libraries do it legitimately.
finding.dex.dynamic_loading.description: It can load more code after installation ({apis}), so what was checked today can change tomorrow.
finding.dex.dynamic_loading.title: Loads extra code at runtime
finding.dex.malformed.advice: Treat the app with suspicion until verified.
finding.dex.malformed.description: {count} code file(s) could not be parsed: either a defect or an attempt to hinder analysis.
finding.dex.malformed.title: Malformed code
finding.dex.missing.advice: Check the other warnings about embedded files.
finding.dex.missing.description: The APK has no valid classes.dex: it is either resource-only or the code is hidden elsewhere.
finding.dex.missing.title: No executable code
finding.dex.obfuscation.advice: Normal in many released apps; context only.
finding.dex.obfuscation.description: A ratio of {ratio} of class names is reduced to one or two letters.
finding.dex.obfuscation.title: Obfuscated code
finding.dex.package_install.advice: Suspicious unless the app is a store.
finding.dex.package_install.description: The code uses the package installer ({apis}).
finding.dex.package_install.title: Can install other apps
finding.dex.root_tools.advice: Banking apps do it for safety; malware does it to see if it can gain admin rights.
finding.dex.root_tools.description: The code checks for root tools ({markers}).
finding.dex.root_tools.title: Looks for root tools
finding.dex.screen_capture.advice: Suspicious unless this is a screen recorder or sharing app.
finding.dex.screen_capture.title: Can record the screen
finding.dex.shell_exec.advice: Rare in normal apps; common in malware and root tools.
finding.dex.shell_exec.description: The code can launch shell commands ({apis}).
finding.dex.shell_exec.title: Can run system commands
finding.dex.sms_api.advice: Suspicious unless this is a messaging app.
finding.dex.sms_api.title: Contains code to send text messages
finding.ingest.path_traversal.advice: Do not open or extract this file: it is not a normal APK.
finding.ingest.path_traversal.descriptio: The file contains {count} entries with paths escaping the folder (e.g. {example}).
finding.ingest.path_traversal.title: Archive with unusual paths
finding.manifest.cleartext_traffic.advic: Data can be read by others on the same network.
finding.manifest.cleartext_traffic.descr: The app may communicate over plain HTTP.
finding.manifest.cleartext_traffic.title: Allows unencrypted traffic
finding.manifest.debuggable.advice: Look for the official release: this may be a developer build.
finding.manifest.debuggable.description: The app is built as debuggable, which a released app should not be.
finding.manifest.debuggable.title: App is in debug mode
finding.manifest.exported_components.adv: May be a security weakness; weigh it with the other signals.
finding.manifest.exported_components.des: {count} components can be reached by other apps without protection.
finding.manifest.old_target_sdk.advice: A technique malware uses to avoid permission prompts.
finding.manifest.old_target_sdk.descript: The app targets Android API {target_sdk}, where permissions are granted without asking you.
finding.manifest.old_target_sdk.title: Built for a very old Android
finding.packer.known.advice: Many legitimate apps (games, banks) use it, and so does malware: weigh it with other signals.
finding.packer.known.description: The app uses {packer} to hide its code, which makes analysis less reliable.
finding.packer.known.title: Protected by a commercial packer
finding.payloads.embedded_apk.advice: Typical of droppers, which install the real malware later.
finding.payloads.embedded_apk.title: Contains a hidden app
finding.payloads.embedded_dex.advice: May be the harmful payload loaded later.
finding.payloads.embedded_dex.descriptio: Code files are embedded outside the normal location ({files}).
finding.payloads.embedded_dex.title: Contains hidden code
finding.payloads.embedded_elf.advice: May be a root tool or a malicious component.
finding.payloads.embedded_elf.descriptio: Native binaries are embedded outside the libraries folder ({files}).
finding.payloads.embedded_elf.title: Contains a hidden native executable
finding.payloads.encrypted_blob.advice: May be an encrypted payload; weigh it with the other signals.
finding.payloads.encrypted_blob.descript: {count} large files look like random data ({files}).
finding.payloads.encrypted_blob.title: Unusually encrypted or packed files
finding.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC: Rarely needed: deny it if you can.
Continuous location access when the app is closed.
Can track you in the background
Allow it only while using the app.
finding.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE: Do not enable it for apps that are not accessibility tools.
It can read the screen and tap for you; many banking trojans abuse it.
finding.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.adv: Be wary: few legitimate apps need this.
finding.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.des: It can lock the phone or make uninstalling difficult.
finding.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LIS: Grant it only to apps you trust.
Notifications contain messages and verification codes.
finding.permission.CALL_PHONE.advice: Suspicious unless it is a phone app.
finding.permission.CALL_PHONE.descriptio: The app can call without your confirmation, including premium numbers.
finding.permission.CALL_PHONE.title: Can place calls
finding.permission.CAMERA.advice: Normal for photo or video-call apps.
finding.permission.CAMERA.title: Can use the camera
finding.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA: Grant it only to file managers or backup apps.
It can read and modify almost every file on the device.
finding.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALL: It can monitor or alter the numbers you dial.
Can see and redirect outgoing calls
finding.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.ad: Used for profiling or hunting for banking apps.
finding.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.de: It can list every app on your device.
finding.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.advice: Most apps do not need this.
finding.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.descrip: The app can see who you called and when.
finding.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.title: Can read your call log
finding.permission.READ_CONTACTS.advice: Ask yourself whether the app has a reason to need it.
finding.permission.READ_CONTACTS.descrip: Your full address book: names, numbers and emails.
finding.permission.READ_CONTACTS.title: Can read your contacts
finding.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Common, but judge it against the app's purpose.
finding.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.desc: Number, device identifiers and call status.
finding.permission.READ_SMS.advice: Only grant this to a messaging app you trust.
finding.permission.READ_SMS.description: The app can read every SMS, including bank and login verification codes.
finding.permission.READ_SMS.title: Can read your text messages
finding.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE: Normal for alarms and sync; suspicious for a simple app.
The app launches automatically at boot.
finding.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.advice: Typical of malware that steals login codes.
finding.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.descripti: The app is notified of every incoming SMS and can read it.
finding.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.title: Can intercept incoming texts
finding.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.advice: Suspicious unless it is a calling, recording or assistant app.
finding.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.descript: The microphone can be used, in the background on older Android versions.
finding.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.title: Can record audio
finding.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA: Suspicious unless the app is a store or file manager.
The app can prompt to install other APKs, a path for downloading malware later.
finding.permission.SEND_SMS.advice: Be suspicious unless this is a messaging app.
finding.permission.SEND_SMS.description: The app can send messages on your behalf, including to premium-rate numbers.
finding.permission.SEND_SMS.title: Can send text messages
finding.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.a: Grant it only when truly needed, e.g. floating-bubble apps.
finding.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.d: The app can display windows on top of other apps, a technique used for fake login screens.
finding.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS.title: Can change system settings
finding.permission.generic.advice: Check that it fits the app's purpose.
finding.permission.generic.title: Sensitive permission: {permission}
finding.strings.discord_webhook.advice: Often used by malware to deliver stolen data.
finding.strings.discord_webhook.descript: The code contains a Discord webhook address.
finding.strings.discord_webhook.title: Sends data to a Discord webhook
finding.strings.dynamic_dns.advice: Rare in production apps; common for throw-away malware servers.
finding.strings.dynamic_dns.description: Domains of free dynamic-DNS or tunnelling services appear ({hosts}).
finding.strings.dynamic_dns.title: Uses free dynamic domains
finding.strings.ip_endpoint.advice: Legitimate apps almost always use domains; direct IPs are typical of command servers.
finding.strings.ip_endpoint.description: {count} web addresses use an IP instead of a domain (e.g. {examples}).
finding.strings.ip_endpoint.title: Connects to direct IP addresses
finding.strings.onion.title: Tor network addresses
finding.strings.telegram_bot.advice: Often used by malware to send stolen data to its author.
finding.strings.telegram_bot.description: The code contains the Telegram bot API address.
finding.strings.telegram_bot.title: Talks to a Telegram bot
finding.yara.accessibility_overlay_banke: This is the typical banking-trojan combination: do not install.
The code combines screen control, overlays and SMS access or icon hiding.
finding.yara.crypto_miner.advice: It drains battery and processing power for someone else's benefit.
finding.yara.crypto_miner.description: The code references cryptocurrency mining software.
finding.yara.crypto_miner.title: Contains a crypto miner
finding.yara.generic.advice: Weigh the app with the other signals.
finding.yara.generic.title: Detection rule triggered: {rule}
finding.yara.icon_hiding.advice: Typical of apps that want to stay installed unnoticed.
finding.yara.icon_hiding.description: The code can remove its launcher entry.
finding.yara.icon_hiding.title: Can hide its own icon
finding.yara.ransom_note.description: The code contains typical ransom-demand phrases.
finding.yara.ransom_note.title: Contains ransomware messages
finding.yara.sms_exfiltration.advice: Typical of verification-code thieves: do not install.
finding.yara.sms_exfiltration.descriptio: The code combines reading SMS with sending data to an outside server.
finding.yara.sms_exfiltration.title: Reads texts and sends them elsewhere
finding.yara.unavailable.description: The YARA engine is not installed, so this check was skipped.
finding.yara.unavailable.title: YARA rules unavailable
